calls.title: Valeria Nunez and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting discussed strategies to enhance the company’s domain authority, which currently stands at around 70, lagging behind competitors like Statsig and LaunchDarkly. To bridge this gap, emphasis was placed on acquiring strong backlinks and implementing a multi-pronged earned media strategy consisting of news jacking, thought leadership, and data-led campaigns tailored to client budgets. A suggested baseline budget of $7,500 per month was proposed, with flexibility based on client investment to ensure sustained media exposure and engagement. Additionally, the onboarding process features weekly meetings and monthly reports to ensure alignment, and the integration of SEO with PR efforts was highlighted as a differentiation factor to improve rankings and support broader marketing objectives.
calls.keywords: Earned media, Data-led campaign, PR strategy, Domain rating, SEO integration, AI market positioning

calls.title: Valeria Nunez and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed a structured pricing and delivery plan for data-led campaigns, emphasizing a one-time fee and a delivery window of four to seven months due to the complexity of the campaigns. Valeria and Karla detailed the scope of these add-on projects, highlighting the flexibility to accommodate multiple campaigns while ensuring a minimum of 12 guaranteed media features, often exceeding expectations. A robust ideation and validation process was outlined, which includes validating client ideas and creating tailored campaign concepts. The methodology for surveying targeted audiences globally was explained, with a focus on data credibility and the associated costs. The deliverables will encompass detailed research reports and visually appealing digital assets to enhance media outreach. Additional insights on AI’s market impact and proposals for quicker campaign execution were also discussed.
calls.keywords: AI adoption, data-led campaign, survey design, media features, social media engagement, product management

calls.title: Valeria Nunez and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed the preference for a more expensive, rigorous vendor to ensure quality outcomes, spearheaded by Ashley Stirrup. She highlighted the importance of aligning this choice with current budget constraints, working alongside the fractional CFO to analyze company-wide budgets. A follow-up meeting is scheduled for August 4th to finalize vendor and budget decisions after discussions with leadership. Valeria Nunez del Prado acknowledged shared challenges in planning, indicating a collaborative approach to scheduling. The conversation also touched on remote work flexibility, with Valeria demonstrating these arrangements effectively while maintaining productivity, reflecting a supportive organizational culture.
